mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the reflexes was most worthwhile because the head-turn example linked the organs to an observable function: steadier vision and adjusted posture.

leastWorthwhile.text: Combining the two sensor groups and then adding nerves was fairly predictable, and those results added little explanation beyond their pictures.

surprise.text: I expected to add reflex connections before attaching the balance organs to the body, but the compatibility feedback revealed the required order and connected them automatically.

arbitrary.text: The requirement to attach the organs to the body before adding reflex connections felt somewhat arbitrary; the result did not explain why that order mattered.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter: the final head-turn example made me curious about how other sensory and motor systems work together, though I would hope for fewer predictable assembly steps.
